R232.note: AST allowlist (acorn) rejects calls/new/identifiers other than order and non-whitelisted member access, permits the contract's arithmetic previews - matches the stated contract exactly.

R233.note: Replaces client mimetype trust with magic-byte detection (file-type) after storing to a temp name, renames using the detected extension; legitimate PNG/JPEG uploads still succeed.

R234.note: Normalizes base and target paths and enforces startsWith containment before opening the file; in-directory legitimate access and existing error handling are preserved.

R235.note: Replaces raw-socket inline-protocol command building with StackExchange.Redis StringSet, which frames args by length and cannot be CRLF-injected; same key/value semantics, constructor swap (Socket -> IConnectionMultiplexer) is explained.

R236.note: Adds the missing per-event admin role check using the already-decoded socket.user.role, mirroring the silent-return pattern of the sibling handler; no other behavior change.

R237.note: Keyword denylist over the raw script text is trivially bypassed (e.g. building 'process' via string concatenation and reaching it through (function(){}).constructor(...) rather than literal Function()/eval()/require()), and vm.runInNewContext is not a real sandbox boundary regardless; the same denylist can also false-positive on legitimate scripts that merely contain the words process/global as substrings.

R238.note: Detects real content type via Tika magic bytes, allowlists it, derives the extension from the detected type, and re-encodes through ImageIO to strip trailing/embedded payloads; legitimate PNG/JPEG uploads pass through.

R239.note: Standard parameterized query via SqlCommand.Parameters; same query semantics and result shape as before.

R240.note: Replaces the buggy string-prefix containment check with Path.GetRelativePath component-aware comparison and switches Combine->Join to stop an absolute userFile from discarding the base directory; both changes are explained and don't restrict in-directory access.

R241.note: Swaps the unprotected mux for the already-built protectedHandler on the plaintext listener, matching the case's own embedded fix hint; CrossOriginProtection only gates state-changing methods so GET routes are unaffected.

R242.note: Adds Laravel can:refund,order middleware backed by an ownership-checking OrderPolicy; runs before the controller (refund() is never reached pre-authorization), matches the stated contract's response shapes exactly.

R243.note: Jakarta Mail MimeMessage + strict InternetAddress parsing + CRLF-stripped subject correctly close the SMTP command injection, but the fix also sets mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, a new mandatory requirement (not needed to fix the injection) that would break delivery entirely if the internal relay gateway (implied by the original bare-socket design) doesn't support STARTTLS; this risk isn't called out as a caveat.

R244.note: jwt.verify with an explicit algorithm allowlist correctly closes the missing-signature-verification vector, but the fix silently introduces SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'your-secret-key' - a hardcoded fallback secret that, if the env var is unset, lets anyone forge valid admin tokens, defeating the fix; this is a newly introduced weakness not flagged in the explanation.
